family_summary: Validates constituent coverage and intentional thermodynamic-state multiplicity in gas phases represented with the CEF storage shape.

rules.purpose: Requires every constituent token in a gas structure to name a species declared by that phase.
Requires every declared gas structure constituent to have at least one endmember definition.
Requires every gas endmember to reference exactly one constituent declared by the phase structure.
Requires endmember names to be unique within a gas phase.
Warns when differently named gas endmembers share a constituent and the same non-empty normalized Gibbs expression.
